production.note: US model years from 2024, still on sale (Ford.com lists the 2026 "Mustang® EcoBoost® Fastback", "Premium Fastback", "Convertible" and "Premium Convertible", source ford-us-mustang-specs-2026). MotorWeek, December 15, 2022, on the 2024 car: "The EcoBoost turbo four-banger...generat[es] 315 horsepower and 350 lb-ft of torque from its 2.3-liter power plant."

body.note: Ford calls the coupe the Fastback. Ford.com weight row "EcoBoost® 3,573 3,724" under Fastback and Convertible columns.

displacementL.note: Ford: "2.3/137.5" (liters/cubic inches). No cc figure printed; 137.5 cu in is about 2,253 cc, which also rounds to 2.3.

drivetrain.note: "Front engine, rear-wheel drive with limited-slip rear differential."

transmission.note: EcoBoost transmission row: "10-speed automatic" (torque-converter SelectShift); Ford.com also lists only "10-speed automatic" (source ford-us-mustang-specs-2026). No manual is offered with the S650 EcoBoost in the US.

powerHp.note: Quote, Ford's 2026 technical specifications, 2.3L EcoBoost I-4 column: "315 @ 5,500" hp and "350 @ 3,000" lb-ft. Ford.com: "315 @ 5,500 rpm (93-octane fuel)" (source ford-us-mustang-specs-2026). Same rating from launch: MotorWeek on the 2024 car, "315 horsepower and 350 lb-ft of torque", "an appreciated bump from the Eco's current 310 horsepower" (source motorweek-mustang-2024-power).

weightLb.note: EcoBoost Fastback with the 10-speed automatic (the only transmission), 2026 model. Quote (Ford's 2026 Mustang Technical Specifications, row "Curb Weight—Fastback/Auto (lbs.)", EcoBoost column): "3,573"; the table is not labelled as estimates. Ford.com gives the same under the heading "Estimated Base Curb Weights": "EcoBoost® 3,573 3,724" (fastback, convertible; source ford-us-mustang-specs-2026). No final Ford figure for 2024 or 2025 could be opened (Ford's September 2022 preliminary sheet gave only estimates), so the reference year is 2026, as in the S650 GT record.
